title: Market search-angle output
description: One angle's search result. SHAPE ONLY — whether a competitor is real, whether an exclusion was fair, and whether a relevance line persuades are the reviewing skill's numbered conditions. The coverage grid and retrieval_summary deliberately duplicate each other: reconciling them is what separates 'we searched and found nothing' from 'we could not search', which is the distinction the whole survey exists to preserve.

map_revision.description: The vocabulary-map revision this run queried from. A run against a superseded map is re-runnable rather than silently stale.

not_run.description: Required when outcome is not_run. An unrun angle owes NO coverage cells — writing empty ones would manufacture zeros that look like searches.

vacated.description: Required when outcome is vacated: the precondition held, but the applicable (group x source) set came out empty, so there was nothing to query.

coverage.description: Required when outcome is ran: one cell per applicable (group x active source) pair. A pair with no cell is an unexplained gap, not a zero.

retrieval_summary.description: Required when outcome is ran. Deliberately duplicates the cell statuses: it is the record a reviewer reconciles the cells against, and a discrepancy is the signal that a failure was laundered into a zero.

fallback_used.description: The registry source id substituted for this one, when the angle's declared fallback was taken.

status_counts.description: cell_status -> count across every cell in coverage.

bound.description: Required when outcome is ran: the per-angle search limit and the ordering it selected by. PRISMA-S wants a limit justified and recorded, not hidden — no cap is applied after the merge, so this is the only limit that exists and it must not read as exhaustive coverage.

ordering.description: How the tail was chosen when the cap bound, e.g. 'directory rank then recency'.

hit.description: Whether the cap actually bound. A cap that bound and is not recorded reads downstream as exhaustive coverage.

dropped_note.description: Required when hit is true: what the limit dropped, in kind.

unadmitted.description: Candidates found but NOT carried forward under the admission rule. Recorded rather than dropped — a silent drop makes 'we did not look' indistinguishable from 'we looked and found nothing', one layer down.

notes.description: Vocabulary discovered mid-run, dead ends, and cross-angle leads. A lead belonging to another angle goes here for the caller to route — chasing it duplicates another worker and corrupts this angle's coverage arithmetic.

cell_status.description: `forbidden-by-terms` is a DELIBERATE non-fetch (the source's terms forbid automated access), distinct from `unreachable`, which is a fetch that failed. Collapsing them would hide a policy decision inside an outage.

queries.description: EVERY query run for this pair, verbatim AS RUN. A paraphrase cannot be re-run, and a coverage record that cannot be re-run proves nothing.

returned.description: Required when status is reached: the result count the source gave back.

kept.description: Required when status is reached: how many distinct candidate ROWS this cell carried forward into candidates plus unadmitted — NEVER a result count. Frequently far below returned, since most results are not competitors; only cap truncation needs bound.hit.

id_class.description: Governs the shape of id: `wikidata` is WD-Q<number>, `package` is a purl, `app-store` is APPLE-/STEAM-<id>, `web` is a MINTED WEB-<official-domain>. A web-class item must NEVER be given an invented registry-shaped id.

url.description: Required when id_class is web: the official site the minted id was derived from.

authority_band.description: Ranking and dedupe input ONLY — never a cut. On conflict first-party wins: aggregators lag pricing by months, a pricing page is definitionally current.

found_by.description: The (group_id, source_id) cell this candidate came out of, written 'group/source'. Use the literal 'map-seed' for a product the vocabulary map already named as a seed rather than one this angle discovered.

admission.description: Why this candidate was carried forward. Listicles and roundups pad with filler, and without this rule each filler entry costs a full deep read. Both limbs are facts the searcher can check; whether the capability claim is real stays the reviewer's.

corroborating_angles.description: Required when basis is corroborated: the two or more INDEPENDENT angles that found it.

capability_stated.description: Required when basis is first-party-resolved: the capability the official site actually states.
